description: This file contains the implementation of creation, initialization, and removal functions for a component object related to BSP Engine Variables. It defines how to create, initialize, and delete a 'String Component Object' using function pointers and object memory management, typical of C object-oriented style. The file also handles setting up method pointers for variable operations.

methods.name: ANSC_HANDLE BspTemplateVarCOCreate(ANSC_HANDLE hContainerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hOwnerContext,ANSC_HANDLE hAnscReserved)
methods.description: Creates and initializes a BSP template variable object, setting its method pointers and initial values.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS BspTemplateVarCORemove(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Destroys the BSP template variable object, freeing allocated memory.

methods.name: ANSC_STATUS BspTemplateVarCOInitialize(ANSC_HANDLE hThisObject)
methods.description: Initializes the object by assigning function pointers for variable operations and setting default values.
